'''Uroro Station''' was a wheel-shaped [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> floating in the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] equilibrium point between the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Qogo]] and [[Uluq]], in the [[Maad system]].<ref name="Invincible" /> It was used as a transfer station for [[Hapan]] ships traveling along [[the Throat]] to the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world [[Shedu Maad]]. However, mining resources eventually vanished<ref name="TCSWE" /> and Shedu Maad was finally abandoned, as well as Uroro Station.<ref name="Invincible" />

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi Coalition]] used the station as a decoy to lure [[Darth Caedus]]' fleet and the fleet of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] into a [[Battle of Uroro Station|trap]] being led by [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and the [[Hapan Home Fleet]]. Luke, along with most of the [[New Jedi Order]] were there along with a select group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] and academy staff to play the part of decoy. The ploy worked though Uroro station was destroyed by the long range [[Turbolaser/Legends|Turbolasers]] of the ''[[Megador]]'' after the Jedi evacuated the station.<ref name="Invincible" />
